caveats: A coarse grid model (10 to 25 km) is not directly comparable with a point gauge or a court-reported figure.
This does not show that no forecast could have worked. It shows that this free model did not flag these two storms.
So Rain-Ready keys its alerts on official IMD warnings entered by an operator, not on its own prediction.
